completeness.proof_invariant: A singleton active determinant bucket must acquire a second contributing triple. All such triples are branched. Once balanced, every optional next monomial is branched. Temporary one-axis collision supports in F2/F3 are repaired by every possible second pure-axis monomial.
completeness.scope: Every exact normalized collision support of coordinate degree at most 7 and at most 6 nonlinear monomial occurrences.
